release_notes: `app.py` `_make_breeze_adapter()`: cache the `BreezeAdapter` by `(api_key, session_token)` instead of building (and re-authenticating against ICICI, ~2.3-2.5s) a fresh one on every request that needs a Breeze client — was the dominant cost behind slow strategy-card/Details-modal loading on Breeze strategies. `app.py` `_leg_candles()`/`live_candles()`: per-(symbol, day) tail-only candle cache instead of re-pulling the whole trading day on every Details-modal refresh; open legs' candles now fetched in parallel instead of serially. `broker/breeze_ticker.py`: closed the `is_verified()` cold-start gap that left `BreezeAdapter.ltp()` falling back to slow REST for up to 30s+ after every restart/reconnect — faster retry cadence while unverified, and a same-token reconnect no longer discards a still-valid verification. `tests/conftest.py`: `kite_ticker.start()`/`breeze_ticker.start()` no-op'd for the test session — `import app` was spinning up a real WS thread against live broker credentials whenever `config.json`'s `ws_ticks` flags are on.
